title: SLA-weighted Deployability Funnel: prioritized roadmap scoring for latency-sensitive workloads
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Introduce a repeatable prioritization framework that augments traditional RICE scoring with two operational dimensions: SLA-weighting (to reflect customer-facing latency/uptime commitments) and a Deployability Index (engineering effort, rollback risk, infra readiness). The goal is to produce a single prioritized funnel for roadmap candidates that balances user impact with unit economics and operational risk for latency-sensitive inference features (e.g., streaming, KV cache improvements, kernel optimizations).
motivation: Existing RICE variants at Redwood emphasize impact and effort but underweight SLA and rollback risk for production inference. Several recent incidents showed high-impact features that increased operational burden and jeopardized latency SLOs. This framework makes SLA-tradeoffs explicit in prioritization conversations and surfaces low-risk, high-SLA-gain items earlier.
detailed_scoring_components: R: reach (active routes/users per week, normalized); I: impact (salience to UX, revenue, or retention); C: confidence (evidence, benchmarks); E: effort (engineering points). RICE_base = (R * I * C) / E. SLA_multiplier = 1 + SLA_priority_weight * SLA_delta_normalized (0..1). Deployability_multiplier = 1 + (0.5 - deployability_score_normalized) * deployability_sensitivity. OperationalPenalty = rollback_risk_score * ops_risk_weight.
parameters_guidance: SLA_priority_weight default 0.6 (higher for enterprise-facing routes); deployability_sensitivity default 0.8; ops_risk_weight default 0.4. Normalization maps raw metrics into 0..1 using historical min/max and capped percentiles.
example_scores: Example A (KV cache per-route caching): R=0.7 I=0.8 C=0.9 E=0.5 => RICE_base=1.008; SLA_delta=0.15 => SLA_multiplier=1.09; deployability_score=0.8 => Deployability_multiplier=1.04; rollback_risk=0.1 => OperationalPenalty=0.04; final score ~1.10. Example B (new streaming encoder): RICE_base=1.2; SLA_delta=-0.3 => SLA_multiplier=0.82; deployability_score=0.45 => Deployability_multiplier=1.275; rollback_risk=0.4 => OperationalPenalty=0.16; final score ~1.06. The framework surfaces KV cache higher despite lower RICE_base because SLA uplift is positive and operational risk is low.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Documented calculation in Confluence with worked examples and spreadsheet. 2) Pilot applied to 12 candidate initiatives from the next cycle and results reviewed with Eng/Design/PM. 3) Two roadmap decisions made using funnel (one candidate accelerated, one deprioritized) with post-hoc telemetry to validate predicted SLA/cost outcomes. 4) Template added to roadmap playbook and scoring tool added as a Google Sheet + CSV export for ingestion into planning tooling.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): internal design and calibration with SRE and core infra; create canonical sheet and example conversions. Phase 2 (4 weeks): pilot with PMs owning inference and infra projects; capture feedback and tune weights. Phase 3 (2 weeks): integrate into quarterly planning ceremony and add automation to import/export from Linear. Phase 4 (ongoing): quarterly recalibration against telemetry (latency, errors, cost per token).
